limitations: The reference arm is the skip-empty XO, not the historical original/combined routed pair.
Both arms inherit the pinned v3 memory, dedicated source-master topology, streams and fixed pipeline assumptions; no latency is fitted.
Only the candidate decodes up to eight row entries from one 64B response; the extent is still a separate read.
Zero-vertex candidates issue no AXI request; simulator commit overhead is not calibrated to the two-cycle RTL invocation.
Full-line row storage must be aligned and padded, including the last partial line; resident initialization is outside this boundary.
Neither arm is linked or routed here. Historical wrapper and block-design identities are topology references, not a new bitstream identity.
GraSU maintenance, DMA, XRT dispatch, inter-round host relaunch and physical BO address capture remain outside this model.
